scope: Two observed cloud instances, same fixed producer and literal private-toolchain/registry/profile prefixes, independently cold-built and booted, complete ELF/initramfs/BIOS byte equality. Schema4 opt-in only.
limits: Actual host identities come from the original recorded socket hostname and os.uname; no cloud-provider instance attestation is claimed.
Literal absolute CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME/native toolchain/profile virtual paths were preserved, not varied.
Fixed selected dependency bytes were restored into a new runtime; the entire host or dependency closure is not immutable.
Canonical metadata and explicit epoch/synthetic embedded builder are part of this opt-in profile.
The frozen producer result.scope historical same-host string remains unchanged; this separate comparison supplies the new cross-instance result.
Successful producer provenance plus stat identities is not immutable compiler artifact content; exact final boot inputs are retained separately.
Query/probe nonzero statuses are preserved and are not failed Cargo compilation units.
